market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from Fed rate-hike repricing, Iran geopolitical premium, and bond selloff. Expect volatility in equities, oil upside, and gold whipsaw. UK M&A and AI infrastructure provide pockets of strength. Crypto pressured by rates but supported by regulatory clarity. 1-3 month: choppy, risk-off bias with energy/defense outperforming.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month: AI capex cycle (SoftBank/OpenAI/nuclear) and China recovery offer structural upside. Crypto regulation maturation (SEC, LSE tokenization) unlocks institutional flows. Energy transition (electricity vs. oil) reshapes commodity landscape. Market concentration correction likely if 1907 signal persists. India EV and retail sectors show structural growth. Key risk: prolonged hawkish Fed + geopolitical escalation = growth slowdown.
